editorial:
Imagine starting at a brand new school only to have the popular kids turn your life into a nightmare. That is exactly what happens here. You follow a new student who gets badly hurt by a group of mean bullies at a California high school. Instead of just crying about it, he decides to get even in the most brutal way possible. The vibe is very gritty and mean, making you feel the frustration of the main character as he plans his payback. It feels like a throwback to those old school revenge stories where the underdog finally snaps and takes control.

What really works is how the tension builds up before the chaos starts. The acting feels real for the time, and the kills are creative enough to keep you interested. Some parts might feel a bit slow, but the payoff is worth it. If you love old school slashers, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the main character successfully trapping his bullies. He uses his knowledge of the school to pick them off one by one. In the final scene, the last bully realizes they are outmatched. There is a big twist where the revenge goes further than anyone expected, leaving the school in ruins. The killer finally gets his peace, but he is left completely alone after his bloody plan comes to an end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 70s slasher films and revenge stories.
